b: When I was 18 war started and I went to another country as a refugee. I didn't speak the language at all and the locals are all elitist pieces of shit that proceeded ro socially exclude me for four years until I reached fluency. Well now I don't want anything to do with them. I fucking hate them all. I despise this country. I tried so hard to get included by people my age and they just ostracized me like I'm not good enough for them. I ended up in a horrible situation after that because I had no support system. Literally nobody to talk to. I am completely alone, I have no friends, no family, I hate EVERYONE. I hate this fucking world built by stupid ignorant men because why am I expected to give a shit about structures and rules that were written by people who didn't think I should have the right ro vote less than a hundred years ago? All those "great thinkers" whose bullshit I have to shove in my head to pass my classes thought of me as a subhuman incubator. Until ten years ago I couldn't get married to who I love. And I'm supposed to give a shit about anything or anyone when this world is literally not for me? I am tolerated here at best. I have nothing in common with most people, I don't like them and they don't like me. I really hate this fucking country and I have no idea how it gets to have a reputation as progressive in the world.

I was in love with someone, I loved her so much, I still do, and she didn't want me. It's not her responsibility to deal with a bitter angry asocial person like me. She's not like that. She deserves someone who is actually happy and someone who wants to be here. Not someone who is below the bottom of the social hierarchy, someone who got sexually assaulted, someone who left their county instead of going to the army.
I really want to kill myself. This isn't worth it. Every time I let myself believe something is going to be okay, it isn't. I just want this all to stop. I hate everyone. Every single person.
